name: Natalia
story: An assassin exiled by the Empire.

skills.name: Assassin Instinct
skills.desc: If Natalia stays in a bush without taking damage for 1s, she will enter Camouflage state and gain 15% Movement Speed. In this state, Natalia's next Basic Attack will teleport her behind her target and deal 200 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage while silencing the target for 0.25s. Dealing damage, taking damage or using skills will immediately end the Camouflage state, but her next Basic Attack will remain enhanced for another 1s. Natalia's base Crit Damage is reduced to 150%, but her damage to Creeps is increased to 150%.

skills.name: Claw Dash
skills.desc: Natalia dashes in the target direction, dealing 250 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in her path. After hitting an enemy, she can cast this skill again within 5s.

skills.name: Smoke Bomb
skills.desc: Natalia releases a Smoke Bomb at her location, slowing enemies within by 25% while Natalia becomes immune to enemy Basic Attacks for 4s.

skills.name: The Hunt
skills.desc: Passive: Natalia gains 15% Crit Chance. Active: Natalia immediately enters the Assassin Instinct state. She can store up to 2 Ultimate charges, and each charge has a recharge time of 30s. Killing creeps reduces the remaining recharge time by 50% of the full recharge time.
